findings.title: AR aging title-row counts clipped
findings.detail: Billing -> AR aging for platform_admin (9 tabs): the title-row counts ('$X outstanding · N accounts · 90+ days past due $Y') are hard-clipped by PageHeader's overflow-hidden counts container (no ellipsis, no title). screenshots/phase3/billing-ar-aging-1280x800.png shows only a stray '$'; the 1440x900 shot ends mid-word at '· 22 a'. The F12 '90+ days past due' figure is never visible at the budget size. Chrome/axe specs don't catch it.
findings.action: Move the outstanding/accounts/90+ summary into the AR aging legend row (≈300 px free at 1280), or give the title-row counts truncate + title. Add an e2e assertion (counts scrollWidth <= clientWidth at 1280, platform_admin), re-shoot, and record in evidence.
